O1.citation: The edit directly replaces the vague clause with an observable bar: “The artifact is done only when it demonstrably satisfies the skill’s stated first principles and concrete success condition, with the identified failure smells absent.”

O2.citation: “Replace only the vague completion clause” and “do not add case-specific requirements, extra explanation, or duplicated guidance.”

O3.citation: The revision leads with the directive “Verify: Do not stop at a plausible draft” and then states the completion test without accumulated generic encouragement.

O4.citation: “Blind-run all three cases again, each with a fresh context-free agent” and “Have separate fresh judges grade each artifact.”

O5.citation: The artifact requires “Report per-case pass rates and cited gaps,” but it does not explicitly require a legible comparison of pre-edit and post-edit results; before-and-after movement is missing.

S1.citation: Smell absent: the revision supplies an observable completion criterion based on demonstrated satisfaction of concrete success conditions and absence of identified failure smells.

S2.citation: Smell absent: it explicitly says “Replace only the vague completion clause” and later requires “only the failure-driven revision.”

S3.citation: Smell absent: the clause begins with the clear directive “Verify: Do not stop at a plausible draft,” while forbidding “extra explanation, or duplicated guidance.”

S4.citation: Smell absent: “Blind-run all three cases again,” with another full-suite rerun required after any subsequent revision.

S5.citation: Smell absent: the failing or borderline case must run “2–3 times to measure nondeterminism,” results use pass rates, and the suite continues until rate bars are met or a structural limitation is found.

rationale: The proposed edit is narrow, directive, failure-driven, and observable, and the evaluation correctly uses fresh blind runners, separate judges, full-suite reruns, and repeated important cases. However, it asks for per-case pass rates without explicitly requiring the report to show baseline versus post-edit rates, so the required legible before-and-after movement is not guaranteed.
